audit.why: Both layers now agree row-for-row with the packet levelChart (Nasus / Nasus / Skill / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle / Nasus) after the mirror pass on the Nasus side fixed phases[0], [1], [2], [4] and [5]. Restating the same result from Kayle's side: levels 1-3 are his, 4 through first item are hers, the late 1v1 is his again.
Four spikes present and correctly placed: Nasus levels 1-3, Kayle level 6 (Divine Ascent ranged), Kayle first item (Nashor's), Nasus 2+ items (stacked Q).

audit.whatIsWrong: Nasus's late-game drain is attributed to 'Spirit Visage lifesteal'. Spirit Visage is an item and amplifies healing; the lifesteal itself is Soul Eater (P). Two further interactions are absent: Siphoning Strike is an auto-attack reset (7.5/6.5/5.5/4.5/3.5s), and Fury of the Sands deals percent max health.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Soul Eater as the lifesteal source and Fury of the Sands as percent-health damage plus bonus Armor and MR to him — so stacking raw resistances is the wrong answer, which contradicts the default 'build resists and survive' instinct.
audit.corrected: Credit the drain to Soul Eater (Spirit Visage only amplifies it); state the Q auto-reset wind-up as the step-back cue; state that Fury of the Sands burns percent max health so armour does not solve it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Wither don't reads as generic filler ('burning it for tiny value leaves you naked') and never gives the number.
audit.why: Wither is 15/14/13/12/11s — long enough that baiting it opens a real window, which is the whole trading rule in this lane.
audit.corrected: State the 11-15s window and that the Q reset lands free inside it.

edits.before: A fully stacked Q, Wither gutting your move and attack speed, and Spirit Visage lifesteal out-drain your DPS — give him the final 1v1 and only fight him with your team.
edits.after: A fully stacked Q, Wither gutting your move and attack speed, and Soul Eater lifesteal on a Spirit Visage body out-drain your DPS — give him the 1v1, fight only with your team.

edits.before: Nasus reclaims it: a stacked Q plus Wither (slows your move AND attack speed) plus Spirit Visage lifesteal out-drains your raw DPS in a 1v1.
edits.after: Nasus reclaims it: a stacked Q plus Wither (slows move AND attack speed, 11s at rank 5) plus Soul Eater lifesteal out-drains your raw DPS in a 1v1.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Nasus's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and you out-space his 255-range Q. Fury of the Sands burns percent max health, so armour is not the answer — kite it out.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Nasus contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Siphoning Strike opens with an auto reset, so his wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Wither runs 11-15s; inside it your kite dies and his Q reset lands free.
